description: This file defines the ContactsService class implementing contact management operations such as searching and adding contacts, leveraging the Contacts framework. It includes methods for authorization, contact lookup, normalization, and payload formatting.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A service class that implements contact search and add functionalities, handling permissions, normalization, and payload mapping.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs contact search based on parameters, supporting name queries with a limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact based on provided parameters, or returns existing contact if matched.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and responds to the contact store's authorization status.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Obtains an authorized contact store, throwing an error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Trims and optionally lowercases an array of strings.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact matching given phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts based on normalized phone numbers and emails.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes phone number strings to digits only.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Constructs a payload object from a CNContact.
